test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 03 May 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

Each band is known across a wide area because all residents of a given region are typically tied to one another through a large ________ of kinship and reciprocity
solution:
The correct answer is **'Option 3' **i.e. **'network'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In this context, the correct word to fill the blank is** 'network',** referring to a group or system of interconnected people or things. 
 
• In this case, **it refers to** the interconnected people through kinship and reciprocity.

Therefore, the **correct sentence** is: *'**Each band is known across a wide area because all residents of a given region are typically tied to one another through a large **network **of kinship and reciprocity.'*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **'Variation' **means a change or difference in condition, amount, or level, typically with certain limits, not suitable in this context.
 
• **'Mesh' **although could refer to a network, it is more often used in a literal context, like a net or a structure made of interconnected lines.
 
• **'Clash' **means a violent confrontation, doesn't fit in this context.
